welcome_page.title: 1. Welcome to About You
welcome_page.description:
This SmartUrbanity questionnaire collects basic personal, household and living-context information. Your answers help describe who participates in the study and how different urban conditions may affect daily mobility. Participation is voluntary. Your answers are not linked to your name. They are stored under a pseudonymous code derived from your email address, so that your answers to different SmartUrbanity questionnaires can be analysed together.

Learn more about SmartUrbanity
